testcase.name: Scenario: Display a large custom command without text: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:121:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Display a large custom command without text ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty custom panel for "Part | 3D Model" ✔ When the user adds "2D Sketches" to the custom panel list ✔ And the user selects "Large" and leaves "Text" clear for the command ✔ And the user clicks "Apply" ✔ Then the "User Commands" panel shows a large command icon without a visible command label ✔ And the customization dialog remains open
